title: The Hawk and Azure Qi Canon
summary: A canon of high plunging strokes and soaring guards in plain qi that ends in one great fall from above.

title: Treatise of the Twin Circuits Unbound
summary: A treatise on loosing both circuits of qi from their paired tracks so they cross and break against one another.

title: The Paired Field Mastery
summary: A mastery of two fields of qi held in tandem that shelter allies and press outward on those who oppose them.

title: Canon of the Azure Pulse
summary: A canon of the great azure pulse of qi that rises through the body and breaks outward in a crest of force.

title: Compendium of the Two-Track Breath
summary: A compendium of drawing breath down an inward track and an outward track and rejoining them in one release.

title: The Hawk's Highest Current
summary: A manual of the highest rising current of qi that lifts the user above a fight and brings the crowning stoop.

title: The Oath Current Canon
summary: A canon of the vowed current of qi that holds its course against every cross-flow and ends in the unbroken vow.

title: Treatise of the Bearing Pulse
summary: A treatise on pulses of qi struck true along a held bearing from the first plumb beat to the final verdict.

title: The Open Sky Oath Manual of Qi
summary: A manual of qi techniques sworn to be seen and made with held breath and nothing hidden from the foe.

title: Manual of the Sworn Field
summary: A manual of the sworn field of qi that covers a company and answers every blow with a swelling crescendo.

title: Compendium of Held Currents
summary: A compendium of anchoring the current of qi to a fixed point and drawing on it to strike mend and judge.

title: Canon of the Long Bearing
summary: A canon of reaching qi along a long true bearing to strike and heal at the farthest edge of the field.
